programs.description: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of the country's most shocking and real-life criminal cases and their investigation.
Siddhi, a dutiful girl, takes care of Maya, her sister with mental illness. However, when Maya regains her sanity, Siddhi's marriage turns troublesome.
Despite being a god, Yamraj has to constantly deal with the problems of a common man.
Anmol, a young woman of short stature, aspires to be a doctor but faces struggles due to societal bias and stereotypes. Despite all the odds, she is determined to achieve her dream.
Agni, a doctor, crosses paths with Vāyu, an investment banker, and the two start to like each other. Together, they try to decipher the mysterious deaths of those who were close to them.
Following the Mahabharata War, the Pandavas and the Kauravas enter the court of Lord Chitragupta and answer his questions about their past actions.
Gauri, a skilled weaver and pride of the community, weaves her dreams through her art. However, a rich woman poses obstacles in her way.
A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the holy scriptures and urges the devotees to follow the path of righteousness.
Lord Brahma orders Ganga, a goddess born from the divine feet of Vishnu and sustained in Lord Shiva's locks, to bless and protect the humans on Earth.
